article.title: The Parish of Seeds
article.author: Jason Collins
article.content: Moira’s Parish of Seeds had been born from the bones of a megachurch that was once known for its large and loud worship sessions. Inside, Moira and her crew had torn out the pews and converted the sanctuary into a seed-curing room. The baptismal font became a hydroponic lettuce tank, and the stained-glass Jesus now watched over shelves of okra, collards, and marigold seeds. Read more via Scalawag : The Parish of Seeds .
